name: UPS
title: 8-K · EX-99.1 PRESS RELEASE SECOND QUARTER EARNINGS

read.thesis: Q2 non-GAAP adj. operating margin rose to 9.2% from 8.8% and FY26 guidance was raised, but US Domestic volume fell 3.3% and GAAP operating margin collapsed to 4.1% on $891M after-tax transformation charges.

capex.quote: The company also confirms expected capital expenditures of about $3.0 billion and dividend payments of around $5.4 billion, subject to board approval.

triggers.label: US Domestic revenue per piece +9.3%
triggers.quote: Revenue increased 6.0%, driven by a 9.3% increase in revenue per piece.

triggers.label: FY26 adj. op profit raised to ~$8.65B
triggers.quote: Raises Full-year 2026 Consolidated Revenue Outlook to Approximately $91.2B and Non-GAAP Adj. Operating Profit Target to Approximately $8.65B
triggers.highlight: Non-GAAP Adj. Operating Profit Target to Approximately $8.65B

triggers.label: Network reconfiguration headcount and facility cuts
triggers.quote: has led, and will continue to lead, to further reductions in our facilities, vehicles, aircraft and workforce
triggers.highlight: further reductions in our facilities, vehicles, aircraft and workforce

triggers.label: US Domestic avg daily volume 16,553K → 16,002K
triggers.quote: Average Daily U.S. Domestic Package Volume (in thousands)
triggers.highlight: Average Daily U.S. Domestic Package Volume

guidance.quote: For the full year 2026, the company is raising its guidance for consolidated revenue to approximately $91.2 billion
consolidated non-GAAP adjusted operating profit to approximately $8.65 billion
non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS to approximately $7.22
expected capital expenditures of about $3.0 billion
We expect to achieve approximately $3 billion in full year 2026 benefits from these initiatives.
we expect non-GAAP adjusted operating expense to exclude between $1.3 and $1.5 billion in cost during the full year 2026
The effective tax rate is still expected to be approximately 23.0%.

red_flags.label: GAAP operating margin 4.1% vs adj 9.2%; $891M after-tax charges
red_flags.quote: GAAP results included after-tax transformation charges of $891 million, or $1.05 per diluted share

red_flags.label: Recurring transformation charges through 2027
red_flags.quote: These initiatives are expected to conclude by 2027.
